services.value: NAREL is “a comprehensive environmental laboratory” that provides services including “the latest health and safety techniques” and “strict monitoring and control of laboratory emissions,” with a mission focused on “measuring environmental radioactivity and evaluating its risk to the public.” It also manages programs/projects including “RadNet (a national environmental radiation monitoring program),” “RERT (Radiological Emergency Response Team),” and “Rapid Radiochemical Analytical Methods.”
